tailBindNote: The tail bones keep the directions of the source in the bind: the short tail hangs back and down from the haunch.

chair.note: The hippo stands in the app (the contrabass stands, soloist of ANIMALS), so no player sits on this seat. The bind keeps the legs of the source, so the seat lies under the back of the haunch, behind the heels (the export refuses a shin or a foot over the seat). The seat is level, and its top is the lowest point of the body over the seat, with no shin, foot, or tail (seat_masks() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py).

eyeBoxNote: The eye box holds the eyeball of each side: a loose dome of 43 vertices, open at its rim (|x| 0.053 to 0.092, y 0.866 to 0.915, z 0.087 to 0.120 in the source, a sphere of radius 0.0277 about (0.0645, 0.8885, 0.0928)). The map paints the iris, the pupil, and a light on each dome. The nose box holds the two nostrils at the front of the snout; the map paints them, so they take no gloss (noGloss).
bodyNote: The facts of the body (BODY_FACTS of tools/body-module.ts) beside the height: the crease angle 180, so that each corner takes the mean normal of the faces at its vertex, as the smooth shading of an FBX viewer shows the source.
